# RMG Tech Solutions

> One stop solution for every machine. RMG Tech Solutions is an MSME Udyam registered and GST registered IT company in Saraswati Vihar, New Delhi. It provides CCTV installation, networking, computer hardware support and upgrades, AMC (annual maintenance contracts), laptop and desktop sales and purchase, and computer accessories for factories, schools, offices and shops across Delhi NCR and Bhiwadi, with supply across India on request.

- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 89292 35937
- Email: rmgtechsolutions1@gmail.com
- Address: WZ-243/182, Street No. 3, Sri Nagar Colony, Saraswati Vihar, New Delhi 110034, India
- Run by: Rajiv Gupta and Mohak Gupta
- Coverage: on-site service across Delhi NCR and Bhiwadi; hardware supply across India on request
- Clients include a manufacturing unit in Bawana Industrial Area (CCTV installation and complete IT management). Also supplies schools and companies.

## Services
- [CCTV camera installation](https://rmgtechsolutions.in/cctv-installation-delhi.html): CCTV installation in Delhi for factories, schools, offices and shops: site survey, HD and IP cameras, DVR/NVR, mobile viewing and AMC.
- [Networking and Wi-Fi setup](https://rmgtechsolutions.in/networking-services-delhi.html): Office, school and factory networking in Delhi: LAN cabling, switches, routers, Wi-Fi on every floor and troubleshooting.
- [Computer hardware support and upgrades](https://rmgtechsolutions.in/computer-hardware-support-delhi.html): Hardware support for offices, schools and factories in Delhi: laptop, desktop and server diagnosis, part replacement, SSD and RAM upgrades, on site.
- [Computer and IT AMC](https://rmgtechsolutions.in/computer-amc-delhi.html): Computer AMC in Delhi for offices, schools and factories: scheduled visits, priority breakdown support, asset records, CCTV and network upkeep.
- [Laptop and desktop sales and purchase](https://rmgtechsolutions.in/laptop-sales-purchase-delhi.html): New and quality-checked used laptops and desktops in Delhi, tested before delivery. Bulk supply for schools and offices with GST invoice. We buy old laptops.
- [Computer accessories and parts](https://rmgtechsolutions.in/computer-accessories-delhi.html): SSDs, RAM, laptop batteries, chargers, keyboards, mice, cables and monitors in Delhi, checked for compatibility and fitted. Bulk supply with GST invoice.
